name: rosetta-fibonacci-n-step-number-sequences
code:
use default

n_step(initial: int[]) -> Pipe[int] is
    let window = LIST(initial)

    for value in initial do
        yield value
    od

    do
        let next = window |> reduce(0, (sum, value) => sum + value)

        yield next

        window.remove_at(0)
        window.add(next)
    od
si

show(name: string, initial: int[]) is
    let series = n_step(initial)
        |> take(10)
        |> map(value => "{value}")
        |> join(" ")

    write_line("{name}: {series}")
si

show("fibonacci", [1, 1])
show("tribonacci", [1, 1, 2])
show("tetranacci", [1, 1, 2, 4])
show("lucas", [2, 1])
